venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Cool autumn night, light rain later in the evening
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 10/10 (MOD JK).** Net sales $4,879 vs target $9,122 (-46.5%). Food $475. 174 guests, $28.04 check avg. Comps $173. Slower night likely due to storm warnings and UGA vs Alabama game; booths full by 5, lull at dinner, pickup around 11. All guests out by 2am. 86 McAllen.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 10/10 (MOD & Chef KE/MD & JMS/DM).** Net sales $7,830 vs target $10,896 (-28.1%). Food $180. ~277 guests, $28.27 check avg. Comps $112 / 1.4% (Industry, Manager Comp, Tech Issues, F&F). Slower Saturday than usual; rain and wind hurt foot traffic. A few pops and lulls, strong finish. Low food sales relative to net. 86 Taco Tuesday.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Beautiful; all of Denver came out
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 10/10 (AM MOD & Chef Carey Lucas; PM Maggie H).** Net sales incl. events $27,186.46 vs target $16,817 (+61.7%); ex-events $16,227.46 (just under target). Food incl. events $7,915.78; net events $10,959. 407 guests (Tock). Comps $550.09. Wedding ceremony/reception for 40 in the Garden & Vauxhall 5-10pm. Understaffed but waitlist most of the night. Maintenance: office and 6A flooded in the morning; TRH taped pipes.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 10/10 (MOD & Chef Seth & Will).** Net sales $7,228 vs target $6,698 (+7.9%). Food $1,042, beverage $6,109. 213 guests, $34 check avg. Comps $229.53 (lots of F&F). Sleepy until 10PM, then busy; many VIPs. Top sellers: Shinebox, Paper Wasp, Rosalie. Maintenance: server drain, one speaker out, popcorn topper missing.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 10/10 (MOD/Chef Julian, Joe, Gigi, Saleh).** Net sales $14,620 vs target $13,870 (+5.4%). Food $2,811. Standing Room $3,749 (food $570); Marquee $10,756 (food $2,214). 391 guests, $37.39 check avg. Comps $365.39. Flooded with guests at open, both rooms busy, waitlist for much of the night; birthdays plus members/investors. Kitchen: 30-min burger waits, need lunch breaks taken ASAP; low on fries. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Cooler, rain later in the evening
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 10/10 (MOD Cory / Marcus).** Net sales incl. events $8,186.78 vs target $9,702 (-15.6%). Marquee bar $7,224.23, Garden $742; food $1,064. 196 guests (121 walk-in / 75 reso), GCA $36.22. Comps $382.17. One walkout (check 46). Carbonation station issue; ADA bathroom lock broken; plumber hydro-jetted the disposal. Full by 7, no late-night pop, last call 1:30.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 10/10 (AM Sam & Marcus; PM Justin & Shannon/Drew).** Net sales $14,981 vs target $15,565 (-3.8%). Morning bar $3,361, evening bar $9,488, Hot Eye $2,027, Sun Club closed. Food $4,000; event sales $4,968 as reported. 373 guests (156 AM + 217 PM OpenTable). Comps $368. Rocky Horror screening at the Lucas drove post-show traffic; Hot Eye packed from midnight. 86 toffee cake.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: High 50s with scattered showers; created a small break in bar flow
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 10/10 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net sales $12,126 vs target $11,761 (+3.1%). Food $1,389. 251 guests (102 reservations), avg guest spend $47. Comps $554 (4.4%; DNLs and service recovery high). Solid flow with a lull around 7:30; Taylor W on training day 2; closed short-handed with no barbacks at 10 (one out sick, one early out). Nothing broken, no 86s.
